cohort: 700 children from the Copenhagen Prospective Studies on Asthma in Childhood(20)(1)(0) mother-child cohort
finding: Several risk factors were identified for an increased burden of asthma-like symptoms in the first 3 years of life, with some showing unique age-related patterns.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with an increased number of asthma-like episodes, with an increasing impact observed with age.
